source_tamil_lines: ஆடவாராய் என்னோடு - மாயக்காரா வா வா வா - ஜாலக்காரா
english_lines: Come dance with me — Mayakkara, come, come, come — Jaalakkara,
I am a queen beautiful like Bhama,
Love I cannot bear blows like burning embers,
Look at this gold that cannot be found,
Look at this body that sprinkles love,
The lightning that races with the sky has become my waist,
My honey-seeping cheek is a divine drink,
Look at these eyes that put the spear to shame,
Look at this speech that enchants a person,
notes: `ஆயர்பாடி கண்ணா`, `மாயக்காரா`, `ஜாலக்காரா`, and `பகவானே` remain culturally audible through transliteration rather than being flattened into generic divine epithets.
`தணலாக வீசுதே` remains the bodily image of love blowing like burning embers.
`வானோடும் மின்னலே இடையாக ஆனதே` keeps the sky-racing lightning becoming the waist, rather than replacing it with a conventional slender-waist compliment.
`வேலைப் பழிக்கும் விழி` is translated as eyes that put the spear to shame, preserving the `vel`/eye comparison.
Repeated invocations and `வா வா வா` remain repeated.

translator_notes: The song's flirtation is image-dense and devotional/playful at once; Bhama, Kanna, Bhagavane, embers, lightning-waist, honey-cheek and spear-shaming eyes remain explicit.
This is a literary source-faithful translation, not a singable adaptation.
